name: Wartburg Castle
description: Perched on a forested crag 410 metres above the town of Eisenach in Thuringia, the Wartburg is a medieval castle that looks much as a storybook fortress should. Martin Luther hid here in exile and translated the New Testament into German. Parts date from the 12th century, though the interiors were largely restored in the 1800s, and the castle inspired Neuschwanstein.
